source_segments.text: 5,195 people, 1,470 households, and 1,230 families residing in the CDP.
As of the 2010 United States Census, [1] there were 12,345 people, 1,542 households, and 1,208 families residing in the CDP.
The racial makeup of the CDP was 81.5% White, 1.4% African American, 1.5% Native American, 0.2% Asian, 12.9% from other races, and 2.4% from two or more races.
Hispanic or Latino of any race were 29.8% of the population.
